pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor"), repeat_givers AS (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count > 1), one_time_givers AS (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count = 1), totals AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM repeat_givers) THEN d."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS amount_repeat, SUM(CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM one_time_givers) THEN d."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS amount_one_time, SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM repeat_givers) THEN d."Donor" END) AS count_repeat FROM donations AS d) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * amount_repeat / NULLIF(NULLIF(total_amount, 0), 0), 2) AS share_percent_repeat, count_repeat FROM totals

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_givers AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count > 1
),
one_time_givers AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count = 1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM repeat_givers) THEN d."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS amount_repeat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM one_time_givers) THEN d."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS amount_one_time,
    SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM repeat_givers) THEN d."Donor" END) AS count_repeat
  FROM donations d
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * amount_repeat / NULLIF(total_amount, 0), 2) AS share_percent_repeat,
  count_repeat
FROM totals;
